what: No un-escalate: a wrongly escalated ticket cannot be returned
note: CONFIRMED with all five not-found checks 2026-09-02. (1) route search: no un-escalate route on any controller; ticketing exposes no generic status PATCH/PUT - every write is a named transition endpoint. (2) backend search: grep -riE for un-escalate/de-escalate/clearFraud/unflag/withdrawEscal over apps/backend/src + apps/admin/src + apps/mobile/src (generated excluded) returns ZERO. (3) permission: not role-hiding - all MANAGER_ROLES may escalate and NO role anywhere has a reversal control. (4) terminology: the same grep covers the plausible synonyms; nothing. (5) another module: ESCALATED is also written by ticketing/repeat-escalation.service.ts:61, and read by ops-explorer/dataset-registry.ts:1577, ticketing/resolved-ticket-status.ts:59 (LIVE_FAILURE_CYCLE_STATES) and ticketing/ticket-query.service.ts:145 - all readers, no writer moves a ticket OUT. The only exit is non-operational.service.ts:52, which auto-closes ESCALATED to CLOSED_NON_OPERATIONAL and requires a customer-confirmed Non-Op reason - a semantically different act (device out of service), not 'that escalation was a mistake'. A ZM who escalates the wrong ticket must either leave a false fraud accusation standing or launder it through a Non-Op close that misstates why.

what: Escalation reason reaches no report, only the audit log
note: CONFIRMED and STRENGTHENED 2026-09-02. Read the write path at verification.service.ts:118-140: the ZM's typed free-text lands in exactly one place, auditLog.metadata { runId, reason } at :138. The sibling TicketEvent at :120 carries reasonCode VERIFICATION_FRAUD_ESCALATED but NOT the reason text - so even a consumer that read TicketEvent would get the label without the why. The strongestAlternative (root-cause aggregates on TicketEvent.reasonCode) is FALSIFIED, not merely unmet: root-cause-aggregation.service.ts contains zero references to auditLog, reasonCode or ticketEvent, and zero this.prisma calls at all. grep VERIFICATION_FRAUD_ESCALATED across backend+admin+mobile returns only the two producing lines. E-10's promised compliance follow-through carries neither the reason nor the reasonCode.

what: Countdown shows overdue for windows the sweep will never expire
note: CONFIRMED 2026-09-02. Two rules, only one shown. DISPLAY rule, verification-query.service.ts:206: partialDeadline = startedAt + 24h whenever outcome is null and pings are 1-2. ENFORCED rule, windowExpired() at verification.service.ts:239: returns telemetryAsOf != null AND telemetryAsOf > startedAt - a null or stalled watermark means the window NEVER expires. The source comment at :230-237 admits the tail exactly ('a window that never expires because the watermark never advances... it must be made visible (slice 3)') and slice 3 is not built. strongestAlternative falsified: grep -iE for watermark/telemetryAsOf/staleness/stale over apps/admin/src/pages/verification/ and apps/admin/src/api/verification.ts returns ZERO, and the VerificationReviewRow contract (api/verification.ts:23-38) carries no watermark or staleness field at all - the page has nothing to render even if it wanted to. The ZM therefore sees a hard 'overdue' chip on a row the system has silently decided not to act on, with no cause displayed and no control to force it.
